The AI-powered fast path to manufacturing
Arda’s AI creates a single source of truth for manufacturing, enabling a new level of production agility. As designs evolve or demand shifts, Arda adapts and optimizes the process – helping manufacturers produce faster and at lower cost.
“We would be behind on our production goals without Arda.”
Matt Grimm

Closing the distance between design and production
Arda is already running across multiple lines at a large US manufacturer. By reducing the manual work involved in process planning, instructions, and design changes, Arda has made key engineering tasks five to ten times faster – saving hundreds of hours, catching production errors, and helping the team get more products off the line.
The result is greater speed and flexibility across the entire production process.
